renewCredential.description: A provider id whose current account's OAuth token is refreshed now unless it lasts `minimumValidityMs` more (the host preflight of a benchmark run); needs `minimumValidityMs`.

terminalsAvailable.description: `false` when the server cannot run terminals; everything else still works.

positions.description: Saved free-floating window positions by display id.

DesktopWorkflowConfigReadParams.description: Params of `desktop/workflowConfig/read`: the JSONC settings file. Answers `{config: object | null}`.

device.description: Empty until the model is loaded.

base.description: Absent or empty: no base branch.

payload.description: The outbound text the card may show; never a secret.

remember.description: The remember scopes the request allows.

browserEngine.description: The browser engine lane (`host/browser/*`, version 1); absent = the `host/browser/command` forward path.

files.description: File snapshots and the local page server.

windows.description: Window objects of the desktop: `host/window/open`, `host/window/close`, `host/window/focus`; sends `host/window/closed`.

resources.description: Where the desktop keeps the server cores and the askpass helper the core launches.

serves.description: The `host/*` methods this claimant serves. Absent: every method of the capabilities declared in `capabilities.host` (the boolean routing); present: a request for a method not listed is not sent to this claimant (`unsupportedMethod`).

serverCoresDir.description: The server cores a connection installs on a server.

HostComputerBlob.description: Bytes the host put in the core's blob store with `blob/put` before it answered.

HostHumanOnlyEndParams.description: Params of `host/humanOnly/end`: the dialog of hold `holdId` closed.

HostRemoteTargetSetParams.description: SSH server core the local core bridges phone connections to (R25).

endpoint.description: `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/rpc` of the tunnel; absent = the local core.

HostStateSetParams.description: Publishes desktop-owned state into section `hostState`: `{key, value}`, the value's shape picked by the key. Only `visualize` is typed; the others stay the desktop's own JSON.

ImageChip.description: Byte-free image metadata of a user row (`images`): its chip.

ImageRef.description: The stored original of one restored `[Image: …]` line (`imageRefs`); an image without a stored original has no `ref`, so later images keep their slot.

ImportedTool.description: One tool of an imported run: its name and how many times it ran.

The calls' results were never imported.

approvalsInbox.description: Receive every pending approval request even without a thread subscription (P §8.3).

feedRanges.description: Folds a feed frame that stands for a run of positions (`feed.from`): the writer may coalesce a thread's text appends for this connection (Node's phone mailbox, `remote-streaming-mailbox.ts`). A client without it gets every frame.

optOutNotificationMethods.description: Exact notification methods suppressed for this connection.

defaultsSeparation.description: Set once per core start, before any connection is served. Absent from a core that predates it; read that as `ok`.

serverInstanceId.description: Changes on every core start; a different value means every held epoch is stale.

InstallableModule.description: A module with a separate install step (`git`, `office`, `tidy`, `visualize`, `media`).

ItemMeta.description: Attributes shared by every item (today's `DesktopTranscriptItem` common fields).

ext.description: Remaining row attributes of today's transcript row.

messageId.description: The stable message id of the row's message (`meta.transcript.messageId`): what a compaction's dropped-message ids and a room line's `room.id` name.

posted.description: Delivered into the thread outside any turn (agent-home delivery).

terminalInputBufferBytes.description: Per-terminal input buffer before socket reads pause (P §7.3).

terminalRingChars.description: Terminal feed replay ring, in characters (`REPLAY_BUFFER_LIMIT`).

LocalGpu.description: One GPU. An Apple GPU reports its name and shared memory only.

checkedAt.description: Epoch ms of the last completed detection.

compatible.description: The GPU has the model's minimum VRAM.

configuredContextWindow.description: The user's context size; `null` runs the default.

present.description: Some file exists, complete or partial.

LocalModelCapabilities.description: What the running server reported when a model loaded.

tools.description: Tool support: `null` when the template does not say.

idleDeadline.description: Epoch ms the idle server unloads, while armed.

installationCommandError.description: The last installation command's failure, until the next command.

installed.description: The runtime is installed and the module is installed.

tokens.description: `null` is the automatic context size (the old main process accepted it: boundary/validate/capability_settings.rs refuses only a size below 16384; boundary/validate/capability.rs still requires the field to be present).

log.description: Redacted tail of the server log.

LocalVerification.description: The last integrity check of the model file.

root.description: The project root; the feed is `lsp:<root>`.

MaybeBlob_for_AnyValue.description: A body that is inline when its encoding is ≤ `INLINE_MAX`, else a blob reference.

MaybeBlob_for_String.description: A body that is inline when its encoding is ≤ `INLINE_MAX`, else a blob reference.

acceptForwards.description: The user accepted the forwards listed in the inspection summary.

settings.description: Entered in the connect dialog's advanced options: used for this attempt and saved with the server.

trustHostKey.description: The user confirmed the fingerprint the inspection reported: save that key first.

SshFailed.description: `{ ok: false, failure }` of a connect or a cleanup.

SshFailure.description: A failure with the code behind its view.

oneOf.description: The key shown was saved, and a server further along the jump chain now needs its own check.
The server's Mixdog speaks another protocol version: reconnecting reinstalls the matching one.
An unexpected error inside Mixdog (bootstrap/protocol), not something the user's server setup caused.
The login shell or home directory of the server answered in a way the bootstrap cannot use.
The server is connected already, so a new login key or folder cannot be tested: disconnecting first is the only way.
The server's own (non-desktop) Mixdog is in the way: it is left running and there is nothing to restart.
Another daemon holds the data folder.

code.description: The error code behind the view (a bootstrap code such as `install-failed`, or the view's own name); shown in the details line.

SshHopKey.description: One server on the way to the target (a ProxyJump hop, then the target itself).

oneOf.description: Not read yet: it is only reachable through a hop that is not trusted yet.

SshHost.description: A saved SSH server. `open` is true while its server window is open.

lastConnectedAt.description: Epoch ms; always written, `null` before the first connection.

host.description: The name to type to confirm replacing the key.

removeCommand.description: The exact command that forgets the old key.

replaceable.description: The old key is in Mixdog's own known_hosts, so Mixdog may replace it; `false`: only the command above does.

SshHostSettings.description: What a saved server remembers besides its name and address.

allowedProviders.description: Model providers this server may use through this PC; `null` or absent: every provider enabled on this PC.

identityFile.description: Private key file on this PC (passed to ssh with `-i`).

modelLogin.description: `server`: the server's daemon runs models with the logins stored on the server; absent or `pc`: with this PC's.

remoteCwd.description: Server folder the session opens in: `~`, `~/x` or an absolute server path.

kind.description: For an unsafe private store: `permissions`, `owner` or `type`.

path.description: The server's secrets folder to repair.

SshMissing.description: Where ssh was not found, and the command that installs it when there is one.

SshModelLogin.description: Whose provider logins a server's models run on: this PC's (the default) or the server's own.

SshNodeProblem.description: Why the server's Node is unusable.

SshOpenEphemeralParams.description: `connections/ssh/openEphemeral`: a dev window for `MIXDOG_SSH_TARGET`, not remembered.

SshServerLog.description: The tail of the server's `daemon.log`, fetched over ssh.

credentialSource.description: An API key's effective source on the server, when it reports one.

fromEnvironment.description: The key comes from the server's environment: it cannot be changed or removed here.

identity.description: A signed-in subscription's account as the server knows it (its email).

keyless.description: A custom provider that needs no key at all.

storedInPrivateFile.description: The key is kept in the server's private secrets file (the server has no OS keychain).

userCode.description: The device code the provider's page asks for, when the URL does not carry it.

oneOf.description: A subscription login.

oneOf.description: Durability waits under slow storage (R12).

expectedTurnId.description: Absent: the core steers the thread's active turn (today's `prioritizeQueued` names none).
